question: What is the strangest thing you have ever won?
story: I won a lifetime supply of hot sauce, and it nearly got me evicted. I was twenty four and bored at a laundromat, so I scanned a code on a bottle and typed my name in. Six weeks later a truck pulled up outside my building. Not a box. A truck. Forty two cases, and a letter explaining that lifetime meant one shipment every three months for the next twenty years. My studio apartment was four hundred square feet. I stacked hot sauce under my bed, behind the couch, and inside the oven, which I then could not use. I gave bottles as birthday presents. I gave a bottle to my dentist. Here is what actually broke me. My landlord did a routine inspection, saw the wall of bottles, and asked if I was running a business out of the unit. I had to sign a letter swearing I was not a hot sauce dealer.
